pages.text: A long line stood in the square. Grandma Bear spread out paper to write down the names for the race.
Soso wanted to race too and stood at the very back.
One by one, those ahead said their names. "Ppino!" "Rudi!"
Soso's turn came. Very softly, Soso said, "Soso..."
Grandma didn't hear. The child behind Soso said their name loudly.
The line was gone. The paper folded shut.
The race began. Soso watched from outside the line.
Grandma Bear lifted Soso's hand. "Raise your hand first, and your words can follow."
They wrote names for the next race. Soso raised a hand high. "Soso!"
Soso stood at the starting line. Soso's name was on Grandma's paper.
